description: Show a section-level diff between two versions of an installed skill. Returns added, removed, and modified headings along with a change type (major/minor/patch) and update recommendation. Requires Individual tier or higher (version_tracking feature).

newRiskScore.description: Risk score of the new version (0–100)

oldRiskScore.description: Risk score of the old version (0–100)
